heading: A real delivery, checked against its source.
scope: One program produced a link inventory. A separately implemented checker and independent review assessed its original submission against the frozen document.

requiredText: The first registered inventory accounted for all 20 supported links and 28 excluded constructs in one committed theory document.
Its original submission passed the separate checker and independent review.
The completed delivery selected preparation of the public research map as its next step.

results.label: Coverage of the source
results.summary: The inventory also identified 28 excluded constructs. All 20 local targets exist in the retained repository tree; rendered links and headings remain untested.

results.label: The first submission
results.measure: passed the separate check and independent review
results.summary: The original bytes and producer claim were preserved before checking. This is one scoped result, not an estimate of general reliability.

limits: One document, one artifact, limited Markdown syntax. Quality, authority and time assurance are separate: verifier and adjudicator authority remain unmeasured, and no independent timestamp witness was recorded.

next.question: What supports each research claim?
next.description: Build a public map that connects claims to their sources, results, qualifications and open questions. Make every displayed relationship readable without using the graph.
next.budget: Start with reviewed public records, accurate links and keyboard access. Measure useful evidence exploration before optimizing reach.
